stories.title: Health Endpoint Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the /health response contract including status (ok/degraded/down), timestamp, service name, version, and optional dependency checks (e.g., MongoDB connectivity). Establish JSON schema and HTTP status code mapping.

stories.title: Core Health Check Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to evaluate system health including app liveness and optional checks (MongoDB ping via shared utilities, external API reachability if lightweight). Return aggregated health status.

stories.title: Expose /health API Endpoint
stories.description: Add FastAPI route /health in main.py that returns the health contract response. Ensure low-latency execution and no dependency on heavy services.

stories.title: Health Endpoint Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating /health response schema, status codes, and behavior under normal and degraded conditions (e.g., simulated DB failure).

stories.title: Integration with Deployment and Monitoring
stories.description: Ensure /health endpoint is compatible with CI/CD and hosting environment (Azure App Service) for uptime checks and readiness probes. Validate endpoint accessibility post-deploy.
